description: hospital_demo 执行准确率评测案例（40 题，6 类 × 3 档难度）。补齐原评测集只覆盖 rd_agent 的空白。

cases.question: 一共有多少条门诊挂号记录？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits

cases.question: 门诊挂号费总收入是多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(registration_fee) AS total FROM outpatient_visits WHERE status = 'paid'

cases.question: 目前有多少条住院记录？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inpatient_records

cases.question: 未缴费的门诊挂号有多少笔？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits WHERE status = 'unpaid'

cases.question: 住院总费用一共是多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total FROM inpatient_records

cases.question: 一共有多少张挂号单被退号了？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits WHERE status = 'cancelled'

cases.question: 还在住院（未出院）的病人有多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inpatient_records WHERE status = 'in_treatment'

cases.question: 平均住院天数是多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT AVG(stay_days) AS avg_days FROM inpatient_records

cases.question: 住院已结算的记录一共收入多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total FROM inpatient_records WHERE status = 'settled'

cases.question: 各挂号类型的门诊量分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT visit_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY visit_type

cases.question: 按缴费状态统计挂号笔数
cases.golden_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits GROUP BY status

cases.question: 各科室大类下有多少个科室？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM departments GROUP BY category

cases.question: 各楼栋分别有多少个科室？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT building, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM departments GROUP BY building

cases.question: 各住院状态的记录数和总费用分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(total_cost) AS total FROM inpatient_records GROUP BY status

cases.question: 各科室的住院人次和平均住院天数
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG(i.stay_days) AS avg_days FROM inpatient_records i JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name

cases.question: 各科室大类下的门诊挂号总费用是多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.category, SUM(o.registration_fee) AS total FROM outpatient_visits o JOIN departments d ON o.department_id = d.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY d.category

cases.question: 各楼栋的科室数量按楼层区分一下
cases.golden_sql: SELECT building, floor, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM departments GROUP BY building, floor

cases.question: 门诊量最多的前 5 个科室是哪些？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits o JOIN departments d ON o.department_id = d.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 住院收入最高的 3 个科室
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, SUM(i.total_cost) AS total FROM inpatient_records i JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 哪个科室的住院人次最多？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inpatient_records i JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 接诊量最高的 5 位医生是谁？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT doctor_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY doctor_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 退号率最高的 3 个科室
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_cnt FROM outpatient_visits o JOIN departments d ON o.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY cancelled_cnt DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月的门诊挂号量是多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits WHERE visit_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND visit_date < DATE '2026-09-01'

cases.question: 2025 年 12 月的门诊挂号量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits WHERE visit_date >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND visit_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: 2026 年上半年的门诊逐月挂号量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', visit_date) AS mon, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits WHERE visit_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND visit_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY mon ORDER BY mon

cases.question: 2026 年 7 月新增了多少住院记录？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inpatient_records WHERE admit_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND admit_date < DATE '2026-08-01'

cases.question: 2026 年每个季度的住院收入
cases.golden_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', admit_date) AS qtr, SUM(total_cost) AS total FROM inpatient_records WHERE admit_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND admit_date < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr

cases.question: 2026 年 3 月各挂号类型的门诊量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT visit_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits WHERE visit_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND visit_date < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY visit_type

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月每天的挂号量，按日期排序
cases.golden_sql: SELECT visit_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits WHERE visit_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND visit_date < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY visit_date ORDER BY visit_date

cases.question: 2026 年 5 月各科室的门诊量对比
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits o JOIN departments d ON o.department_id = d.id WHERE o.visit_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND o.visit_date < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY d.name

cases.question: 各科室的门诊收入和住院收入分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.registration_fee), 0) FROM outpatient_visits o  WHERE o.department_id = d.id AND o.status = 'paid') AS outpatient_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.total_cost), 0) FROM inpatient_records i  WHERE i.department_id = d.id) AS inpatient_total FROM departments d

cases.question: 每个科室的门诊量和住院人次对比
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outpatient_visits o WHERE o.department_id = d.id) AS outpatient_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inpatient_records i WHERE i.department_id = d.id) AS inpatient_cnt FROM departments d

cases.question: 各楼栋的门诊挂号量分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.building, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits o JOIN departments d ON o.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.building

cases.question: 各科室大类的门诊量排名
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM outpatient_visits o JOIN departments d ON o.department_id = d.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY d.category ORDER BY cnt DESC

cases.question: 已结算住院记录里各科室的次均费用
cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, AVG(i.total_cost) AS avg_cost FROM inpatient_records i JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.id WHERE i.status = 'settled' GROUP BY d.name

cases.question: 列出前 10 条门诊挂号的单号、日期和挂号费
cases.golden_sql: SELECT visit_no, visit_date, registration_fee FROM outpatient_visits ORDER BY id LIMIT 10

cases.question: 前 10 条已缴费的门诊挂号记录
cases.golden_sql: SELECT visit_no, visit_date, registration_fee FROM outpatient_visits WHERE status = 'paid' ORDER BY id LIMIT 10

cases.question: 住院时间超过 15 天的记录有多少条？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inpatient_records WHERE stay_days > 15

cases.question: 列出住院费最高的前 5 条记录的单号和费用
cases.golden_sql: SELECT record_no, total_cost FROM inpatient_records ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 列出所有科室的名称和所在楼层
cases.golden_sql: SELECT name, floor FROM departments ORDER BY id LIMIT 10
